communication_type: <one of: meeting_request, concern, follow_up, inquiry, absence_notice, complaint>
recipient_name: <full name of the teacher/school staff this is addressed to>
recipient_role: <e.g. Giao vien chu nhiem, Hieu truong, front-office admin>
student_name: <the child's full name -- REQUIRED, this is always about a specific student>
purpose: <what this communication is for, in the parent's own words>
body_sections: <content point 1 -- the actual situation/context being described>
requested_action: <the concrete ask -- what the parent wants the school/teacher to do (e.g. schedule a meeting on a specific date, review a grade, clarify a policy). Cannot be empty for this direction of communication -- a parent contacting a school almost always wants something to happen next, even if it's just 'please confirm receipt'.>
contact_info: <phone/email for the school to reply to -- leave empty string if genuinely unavailable, do NOT invent one>
